name: Dimethyl propylphosphonate
description: Dimethyl propylphosphonate (CAS 18755-43-6 ) is an organophosphorus ester used in polymer and specialty chemical formulations as both a flame retardant and a plasticizing agent. Its dual functionality allows formulators to address fire performance and flexibility requirements within a single additive. This versatility reduces the need for multiple components in complex chemical systems. In plastics and polymer systems, it is incorporated into resins and coatings to impart flame retardancy while simultaneously improving substrate flexibility. This specific combination reduces the overall additive load in finished compounds. Home care and industrial cleaning formulations use it as a functional solvent or co-solvent component where phosphonate chemistry supports soil removal and formulation stability. It is also evaluated as a reactive intermediate or modifier in specialty polymer synthesis. Here, the phosphonate group can be integrated into the polymer backbone for durable flame retardant performance that lasts the life of the product. Industrial coating systems targeting fire-resistance standards benefit from its compatibility with a range of resin types. This compatibility ensures that the structural integrity of the coating remains intact while providing essential safety features. Dimethyl propylphosphonate is supplied as a liquid for ease of handling in manufacturing environments. It is available in technical grade suitable for industrial and polymer applications requiring consistent chemical properties. Packaging options typically range from drums to IBC containers depending on order volume. This flexibility in logistics ensures that both small-scale specialty producers and large-scale industrial manufacturers can meet their specific supply chain needs.
